review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 75 bytes, 22 instructions, 6 blocks, 7 edges; both decoders and the emitted candidate report 6/7, score 1.000.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: Block and edge counts match retail exactly (6/7): the scan loop, the free-slot exit, and the error-and-spin exit.

checks.name: scan_bounds
checks.rationale: Scan starts at the flag byte 0x00A952A4 and ends at 0xa962e4 with stride 0x208; the extent follows from the two addresses retail compares, not from an assumed count.

checks.name: free_slot_write
checks.rationale: Stores the name pointer at 0x00A950A0 + index*0x208 and sets the +516 flag byte to 1; retail computes index<<6 + index then <<3, i.e. index*520, and the C++ keeps the 0x208 byte stride.

checks.name: error_path
checks.rationale: Calls Debug_Error with the exact retail bytes "RenderMode: Failed to create new rendermode '%s'" and the name forwarded, then spins at a jmp $, reproduced as an empty infinite loop.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: One cdecl argument read from [esp+4] and stored verbatim; nothing else is read.

limitations: Runtime unobserved; the table starts zeroed, so every slot reads free exactly as an unwritten table would.
0x00A950A0 has no external owner, so this file defines it; the record's fields beyond the +0x00 pointer and the +0x204 flag are not established.
Eight records is what the scanned extent 0x00A962E4-0x00A950A0 = 0x1244 yields at 0x208 stride, not an independent assumption.
